business_problem: A complex multi-system cloud estate slowed analytics delivery, increased maintenance overhead, and made it hard for Neema to innovate quickly on pricing and customer-facing AI use cases.
solution_summary: Neema consolidated its data and AI stack onto Snowflake so reporting, operational workflows, marketing automation, and new AI services could run from one agile platform. Internal dashboards and reports now read from a single repository, while marketing and onboarding workflows use the same data to target campaigns and personalize account setup. The most advanced implementation is an AI pricing copilot: Neema combines public competitor pricing, exchange rates, and internal commercial data in Snowflake, then uses Cortex AI to ground a Mistral model that generates benchmarked pricing recommendations for business opportunities. Reps receive suggested offers, margin context, and alternatives in about 40 seconds instead of manually searching documents and spreadsheets. Snowflake’s sharing model also simplifies activation in systems such as HubSpot, giving Neema a faster path from experimentation to production AI.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Serves as Neema's central repository for internal business data, pricing context, and operational workflows.

solution_components.name: Cortex AI
solution_components.role: Provides the in-platform AI capabilities that orchestrate pricing-recommendation workflows and future AI features.

solution_components.name: Mistral
solution_components.role: Supplies the language model used to generate benchmarked pricing recommendations for sales teams.

solution_components.name: HubSpot
solution_components.role: Consumes shared data for downstream go-to-market and customer-engagement workflows without heavy reverse ETL.

data_flow: Internal business data and public competitor pricing are centralized in Snowflake, where Cortex AI grounds a Mistral model that generates pricing guidance for sales teams.
